goal: Fix the ten confirmed reliability and measurement issues in jev-skill-router review 921faed, without adding MCP, embeddings or dependencies.
acceptance: Offline regression tests reproduce then prevent index loss on discovery/fetch failure; truncated discovery is rejected and successful rebuilds atomically remove confirmed upstream deletions.
Complete bounded metadata parsing and Unicode-preserving metadata grouping retain source identities, invalidate stale parser caches and report fetch/parse/missing-field coverage separately.

Malformed Jev containers and numeric values never crash validation; inconsistent score distributions are rejected; empty rankings fail, partial results are explicitly degraded, permanent errors are not retried and transient errors back off.
CLI rejects negative or unbounded request sizes, IDF rules handle empty and out-of-vocabulary input, and the eval acceptance gate measures the active rule rather than the winning experiment.

Route and report artifacts preserve the candidate set, actual corpus/query/model/timing provenance and separate retrieval recall from validation failures; docs correct the false lexical-ceiling diagnosis.

All checks pass, independent spec and quality reviews approve, and the executor records real read-only corpus measurements and a live route/report result or an exact network blocker. Other projects and production stay untouched.
checks: python3 -B -c "import ast,pathlib; [ast.parse(p.read_text()) for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.py')]"

test.when: The offline regression suite does not yet reproduce all confirmed review issues
test.brief: Write the smallest stdlib unittest regression checks for the ten findings and run once to capture RED evidence. Do not change implementation or weaken assertions.

fix.when: Regression checks fail or any review finding remains unfixed
fix.brief: Fix only the confirmed review issues, preserve the last good index on harvest failure, harden the Jev boundary, and correct gate/report provenance without adding dependencies or changing the default retrieval rule.

docs.when: Code checks are green but documentation or real integration evidence is incomplete
docs.brief: Correct the lexical-ceiling claim, document actual behavior and record real corpus/live route/report evidence. Do not invent output or modify unrelated systems.
